title: Request drones on a mark or area
breadcrumb: Request drones on a mark or area

slides.title: Who answers your request
slides.html: Drones opens OpenDefence UAVOps, a separate plugin used here to show how a request travels. You ask from OpenDefence Main, and those you ask answer in Drones.

slides.title: Tap the target button
slides.html: Tap the enemy mark, or an enemy or unknown area's outline, then the crosshair target button in the ring of buttons. If ATAK lists several items, tap the right one.

slides.title: Read the sheet
slides.html: To first offers the team your daily quota is on, here 2R/1J, and Your quota shows the requests left today. Send turns on once each choice has a pick.

slides.title: Pick and send
slides.html: Pick Strike or Recon, the priority, and under To your quota's team, Any to ask every team, or HQ when it does not matter who flies. Tap Send.

slides.title: Follow it in the Inbox
slides.html: Tap Inbox. Your request shows under Sent with the time you sent it.

slides.title: Read the answer
slides.html: Open Inbox again to see the answer on the same row, here Declined: weather with a blue dot. Tap the row to show the target on the map.

slides.title: Ask about an area
slides.html: You can also ask from Drones, here for an enemy or unknown area drawn with Markers. Tap Drones, then Ask for a drone.

slides.title: Tap the area
slides.html: Tap the area's yellow outline, since a tap inside it does nothing. The phone's Back button cancels.

slides.title: Recon comes picked
slides.html: For an area, Recon comes already picked. Pick who to ask and tap Send.
